name: 81648 · Rangely, CO
findings: ZIP 81648 (Rangely) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81648 (Rangely) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
70% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
